# authwise_guard_node_group (Data Source)

A Guard node group: a named set of a network's nodes that grants and serving name as one. A group may be granted what its members reach (`authwise_guard_node_group_grants`), be granted to a node or another group (members are reached as one), and serve a resource (`authwise_guard_resource_node_groups`: every member serves it). Members are added by hand (`authwise_guard_node_group_members`) or by the credential a node joins with: an `authwise_guard_enrollment_key` or `authwise_guard_cluster_trust_rule` that names the group adds each node it enrolls, so a pod that joins is reachable and served at once. A group named by an unrevoked enrollment key or a cluster trust rule is not deleted (`NODE_GROUP_IN_USE`): Terraform's dependency order removes those first when they reference this resource. Deleting a group removes its memberships, grants and serving; the nodes stay. This data source reads one by its full resource name.
